title: Access
description: Manage project content access and connect Codex, Claude or other clients.
name: Client name
allProjectsHint: Includes future projects as your account gains access.
oneTime: Save this key now. It will not be shown again.
unavailable: Client access is unavailable. Try refreshing the list.
invalidInput: Check the name, projects, permissions and expiry.
forbidden: You do not have permission to register this client.
notFound: This client is no longer available.
limit: The client limit has been reached.
guide: Register the downloaded file, configure the key through stdin, then install the Panda skill or MCP server. Keys remain outside model context.
scopeRequired: Select at least one permission and, for a limited key, one project.
accessBoundary: These permissions cover search, knowledge workflows and registered clients. Workspace and session access follow the installation’s sharing policy.
accessRestricted: Default: access requires a project grant.
accessShared: Default: signed-in members share access to projects.
accessManaged: Share your member ID with an administrator to request project access. Your personal content stays available.
accessAdminHint: Grant read/search access or allow knowledge workflows. Installation administrators always retain full access.
accessConflict: Permissions changed. Reload grants and review them before saving again.
accessUnavailable: Access could not be confirmed. Reload grants before trying again.
botDescription: Create dedicated bots, issue scoped API keys and review queued tasks.
botEmpty: No tasks yet. Submit a task through the API.
botNoBots: Create a bot before issuing a key.
botConfirm: Confirm POST callback. A previous request may already have taken effect; verify the external task before retrying.
botKeyOnce: Copy this key now. It will not be displayed again.
botError: Operation failed. Check your input and try again.
botConfirmDiscard: Confirm discarding this external task? This calls the configured POST callback.
botModelUnavailable: This model is no longer available. Choose another model.
botConfirmDeleteRecord: Delete this task record from Panda? This does not call the business callback. To submit it again, use a new idempotency key.
botDeleteRunning: This task is running. Wait for it to finish before deleting its record.
botTaskDeleted: This task record was deleted. Use a new idempotency key for a new submission.
botCallbackRequired: No callback is configured for this outcome.
botCallbackHostDenied: This callback host is not allowed. Update the Bot’s allowed callback hosts before trying again.
botDiscardSubmitted: Discard callback queued. Check the task status for the result.
botWorkspaceHint: Track tasks, review results, and follow up.
botSettingsHint: Manage your Bots, their behavior, and API access.
botRecentHint: Search all tasks. Open a task to see its input, decision and activity.
botNoMatchesHint: Try a different search or reset your filters.
botEmptyHint: Tasks will appear here when your application sends them to a Bot.
botNoBotsHint: Create a Bot to define its role, choose a model, and connect your application.
botCodeHint: A permanent API identifier. Use lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
botInstructionsHint: Describe what this Bot should evaluate and how it should decide.
botHostsHint: One allowed domain per line. Leave blank if this Bot does not call external callbacks.
botCreateHint: Give this Bot a clear role. You can update its behavior later.
botEditHint: Changes apply to new work. Its API identifier and existing tasks are retained.
botLoadFailed: Couldn’t load this page. Try again.
botPausedHint: New model work is paused. Existing records stay available.
botKeyHint: Grant access only to the Bots this integration needs.
botKeyEmptyHint: Create a scoped key to connect an application to your Bots.
botReadOnlyCode: The API identifier cannot be changed after creation.
botNotFound: This task is no longer available.
botRevokeConfirm: Revoke this API key? Applications using it will lose access.
botAvatarHint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP · up to 2 MB
botPersonaHint: Give your Bot a character of its own. Work requirements still guide its decisions.
botPreviewRole: A little personality. A lot of possibility.
botGentleTraits: Patient, attentive, and considerate. Notice small details and explain uncertainty with care.
botGentleVoice: Warm and clear. Offer practical next steps without excessive praise.
botPreciseTraits: Calm, evidence-driven, and methodical. Check assumptions and distinguish facts from guesses.
botPreciseVoice: Precise and structured. Keep conclusions concise and explain the evidence.
botCuriousTraits: Curious, imaginative, and resourceful. Explore useful alternatives while respecting evidence.
botCuriousVoice: Lively and approachable. Use light humor when appropriate, without obscuring the result.
botDirectTraits: Pragmatic, decisive, and focused. Prioritize what matters and flag risks plainly.
botDirectVoice: Brief and direct. Lead with the conclusion and avoid filler.
botAvatarInvalid: Choose a valid PNG, JPEG, or WebP image up to 2 MB.
botAvatarBusy: Another avatar is being processed. Try again shortly.
botCopyFailed: Copy failed. The API key is selected; copy it manually.
botLifecycleUpdated: Execution state updated. Business outcomes and external action records are preserved.
botErrorCallbackInFlight: The external callback is in flight or its result is unknown. Verify its result before canceling.
botConfirmCancel: Cancel this task? Remaining execution will stop. External actions already completed will not be undone.
botRetentionHint: Default: 5 days. Completed, canceled and failed-delivery records expire in batches. Queued, running and unresolved tasks are protected. Minimal idempotency markers remain to prevent replay.
botQueueStatesHelp: Created and running tasks appear under In progress. Execution status, business decisions and callback delivery are separate.
botReviewDirectionHint: Choose an option, add guidance, or use both. The Bot will continue with your reply.
botReviewLegacyHint: Describe the next step. The Bot will continue from its existing conversation.
botReviewSubmitted: Your reply was recorded. Check the task for the next step.
botReviewRetryReady: No reply is recorded yet. Your draft is kept; continue again when ready.
botReviewAnswerRequired: Choose an option or enter guidance before continuing.
botConfirmReviewAction: Continue with “{action}”? This sends the task’s declared POST callback.
botReviewUnknown: The reply could not be confirmed. Your draft is kept. Check status before submitting again.
botConfirmRetryAction: Retry “{action}”? A previous callback may already have taken effect. Verify its external result first.
botCallbackRetrySubmitted: Callback retry requested. Check the task status for its result.
botReviewStale: This question was updated or answered elsewhere. Your draft is kept. Open the latest question before continuing.
botReviewInvalid: The review choices are unavailable. Refresh the task to read its latest question.
botImageConfirmationUnavailable: Image confirmation could not be completed. Retry or provide accessible task images.
botModelRateLimited: The model provider has reached a usage or rate limit. This task stays queued, and this Bot waits five minutes before trying again. Check the provider quota or choose an available model.
botModelAuthenticationFailed: The model provider rejected authentication. Check the configured credentials before continuing.
botModelExecutionFailed: The model run failed before a usable decision was recorded. Check engine availability before continuing.
botDecisionMissing: No valid task decision was recorded. No external action was sent. Check the model run before retrying.
botRetryFailedHint: Only execution failures are queued for analysis again. Completed tasks, human reviews and uncertain or failed callbacks are skipped. Original task IDs and inputs are kept.
botRetryConfirmCount: Queue these {count} failed tasks for analysis again?
botRetryNone: No eligible execution failures match this selection.
botRetryLimit: Select at most 500 tasks. Narrow the filters to retry another batch.
botRetryQueued: Queued {queued} tasks; skipped {skipped} tasks whose state changed or requires separate handling.
botRetryUnknown: The response could not be confirmed. Retry here to check the same batch without queuing it twice.
botDeleteBatchHint: Queued and running tasks will be stopped before deletion. Callbacks already in flight or with unconfirmed results remain for review. Submission deduplication records are kept; a new business instance can use a new submission key.
botDeleteBatchDone: Deleted {deleted} tasks; {blocked} could not be deleted.
botDeleteBatchUnknown: The deletion result could not be confirmed. Retry to continue safely; already deleted records will not run again.
botDeleteLimit: Select at most 10,000 matching tasks at a time. Narrow the filters to continue.
botDeleteAssistantHint: Delete this assistant, its conversations, tasks and dedicated integration settings permanently? API keys will lose access to this assistant; shared connections and access to other assistants are kept. Stop pending tasks and conversations, disable integrations and reconcile unknown deliveries first.
botAssistantBusy: This assistant has pending or running work, an enabled integration, or unfinished delivery/cleanup. Stop the work, disable integrations and resolve uncertain results before deleting.
botEffortHint: Applies to the next chat message and newly started background tasks.
botEffortChooseModel: Choose a model to see its supported reasoning levels.
botEffortUnavailable: The saved reasoning level is unavailable in the current catalog. It will be kept unless you change it.
